Neverwinter Nights: Wyvern Crown of Cormyr v1.1

Start level: 6 or 7 with a new character (automatically leveled)
Class: Designed for martial types. 
No. of players: 1
Race: Any
Resting: 1 per hour except in inns.
Death: Permanent without a companion
Respawn Penalty: Minor XP
Notes: Character should have a single first and last name to avoid odd dialog. Some Forgotten Realms deities also have benefits - choose or the module will auto-assign one based on your alignment.

Cormyr, the land of your birth, and the land you love, is a different place from the land you left. When you set forth upon your adventures, Cormyr was an oasis of stability, enjoying the long and largely peaceful reign of King Azoun IV. When rumors of war reached you on your travels, you rushed back to find Cormyr very different.

Victory and peace have come at a great cost.

But with the Sembians agitating to the east, a strange silence to the north and lawlessness along the forest edges, Cormyr's troubles are far from over...
Neverwinter Nights - Wyvern Crown of Cormyr
